scope: Только первый блок Смолевичей, четыре варианта

prompts.corner: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: replacement hero photograph for a Russian custom-kitchen website, landscape 3:2. Generate one new highly realistic interior photograph of a practical L-shaped fitted kitchen in a modest modern Belarusian apartment. The defining feature MUST be clearly visible: two continuous perpendicular runs of base cabinets and countertop meeting in a genuine 90-degree corner along TWO walls, upper cupboards above both runs. Show the whole L in a wide view from the open room center. Warm light-grey matte flat fronts, subtle pale oak accent, light laminate countertop. Sink on the short leg, induction hob and oven on the long leg, uninterrupted usable preparation countertop between them, integrated dishwasher closed beside sink, tall refrigerator at outer end. Leave the central floor open and clearly show usable walking space. Natural window daylight, restrained everyday interior, real joinery, plausible hardware, straight cabinet geometry, photographic material texture, eye-level 28mm architectural photograph, no people. Not a 3D render or glossy CGI. No island, no peninsula, no U shape, no extra third cabinet wall, no overdecorated luxury mansion, no lettering, logos, trademarks or watermark. The kitchen geometry and placement must faithfully show 'угловая кухня: две рабочие стены, место для подготовки продуктов, доступ к мойке и открывание техники'.
prompts.straight: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: new hero photo of a STRAIGHT custom kitchen, landscape 3:2, Russian kitchen website. One realistic architectural interior photograph, eye-level 28mm, showing a single uninterrupted 3-meter run of kitchen cabinetry arranged along ONE wall only. Entire run visible from tall refrigerator cabinet at left to the last cabinet at right. Sink at left end, induction hob and undercounter oven at right end, at least one clear generous preparation countertop zone BETWEEN sink and hob. Pale grey matte flat fronts with subtle warm pale oak base fronts, laminate countertop, two visible drawer stacks, upper cabinets aligned on the same single wall. Narrow elongated apartment room, open floor in foreground, modest breakfast table along opposite side outside main kitchen line. Natural daylight from a window in a side wall; authentic textures, practical everyday joinery and realistic appliance proportions. All cabinets must be in one straight line, no corner cabinet run and no cabinetry along either perpendicular wall. No island, peninsula, L shape, U shape, excessive decor, people, visible writing, logos or watermark, no CGI or 3D render appearance. The image MUST faithfully illustrate: 'Прямая кухня: одна линия шкафов для вытянутой комнаты или студии, рабочая поверхность между мойкой и плитой'.
prompts.small: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: new hero photo of a COMPACT fitted kitchen, landscape 3:2, Russian custom-kitchen website. A highly realistic interior photograph of a genuinely small apartment kitchen, approximately 6 square meters, clearly compact, not a large room. Single straight run only about 2 meters long with sensible compact sink on the left, clear preparation countertop in the middle, a two-zone induction cooktop above a compact integrated oven on the right. Closed integrated dishwasher and efficient visible drawer fronts, small upper cupboards with useful storage, matte warm white fronts, small pale oak niche, modest light laminate counter. A plain compact refrigerator located beside the kitchen line, not blocking the passage. Frame the entire compact cabinet run and foreground floor to make the free walking passage unambiguous; a small round table may be partly visible at the opposite window without crowding the path. Natural diffuse daylight, 28mm camera, accurate materials, realistic workmanship and hardware, domestic lived-in restrained look. This MUST visually differ from a spacious standard kitchen: short run, small room, compact appliances, meaningful drawers and open passage. No large island, no peninsula, no enormous room, no luxurious full-wall storage, no people, lettering, logos, watermarks, impossible geometry, CGI or 3D render appearance. Faithfully illustrate 'Маленькая кухня: ящики и встроенная техника под размеры помещения, свободный проход'.
prompts.house: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: new first-screen kitchen photo for a Russian custom-kitchen website, landscape 3:2. Generate one realistic eye-level architectural interior photograph of a spacious but attainable family kitchen in a private house. Bright warm ivory matte cabinets, natural pale oak island/peninsula accent and pantry tall cabinets. A large working kitchen with an L-shaped perimeter, sink near the large garden window, a distinct full-height appliance/storage block with integrated oven at an ergonomic height. Include ONE short connected peninsula for two breakfast stools, NOT an extra floating island. The defining feature: wide clear unobstructed passage of approximately 1100 mm between the peninsula and opposite cabinets, clearly visible in the composition; generous working surface and meaningful closed storage for a family. The room opens to a modest living/dining space, garden view through large window, natural warm daylight, real wood and matte surfaces, restrained styling, correct construction, sensible plumbing and appliance positioning. Frame the full kitchen, peninsula connection, tall cabinet block and open walking area; eye-level 24-28mm photo. Realistic interior photography with natural material detail, not glossy CGI, not a 3D render. No people, huge luxurious mansion, impossible cabinet shapes, blocked walkways, multiple islands, text, logos, brand marks or watermark. Faithfully illustrates 'Кухня для частного дома: рабочие зоны и хранение для кухни-гостиной; полуостров только при достаточных проходах'.
